Amendment No. 1 – VAT Compliance Update

This amendment pertains to Law No. 009/2025 (effective May 27, 2025), which revises Law No. 049/2023 on Value Added Tax (VAT). The updated legislation amends Article One by removing the VAT exemptions previously granted under items (q) and (r) of Article 8.

As RISA (the central purchasing body for ICT equipment/services) had entered into supplier contracts under the former VAT-exempt framework, this amendment introduces an 18% VAT on all ICT equipment and services to align with the new legal requirements. All other terms and conditions of the original contract remain unchanged.

description:
Amendment Clauses

Clause 1: Purpose of the Amendment
The purpose of this Amendment is to extend the contract duration, revise the contract amount, and modify a specific item in the contract.

Clause 2: Amended Contract Duration
The Contract duration is hereby extended by two (2) months and fifteen (15) days.

Clause 3: Revised Contract Amount
The Procuring Entity agrees to pay the Contractor, in consideration of the execution and completion of the Works and the remedying of any defects therein, a revised total Contract Amount of Nine hundred ninety-nine million eight hundred one thousand seven hundred forty-one Rwandan Francs (Frw 999,801,741), resulting from the change of item. 

Clause 4: Change of Item
Item 39.27.2, originally described as:
“Supply and installation of new steel tank of steel plates 800mm × 800mm, 16mm thick of good quality, with revamping of supports (trusses)”

is hereby amended and replaced with the following description:
“Supply and installation of a Glass Reinforced Plastic (GRP) tank with steel plate dimensions of 1000mm × 1000mm and a thickness of 5–6mm.”


Clause 5: Performance Security
The Performance Security shall be five percent (5%) of the revised Contract Amount, denominated in the same currency as the Contract Price, and provided in the form of an insurance bond.
The corresponding value of the Performance Security is Forty-nine million nine hundred ninety thousand eighty-seven Rwandan Francs (Frw 49,990,087).

Clause 6: Validity of Original Contract Provisions
Except as expressly amended herein, all clauses, terms, and conditions of the original Contract shall remain in full force and effect.

All other terms and conditions of the original contract remain unchanged.

description:
This amendment is made in order to implement the assigned responsibilities as per the Memorandum of Understanding signed between Rwanda Demobilization and reintegration Commission, Rwanda Space Agency (RSA) and Rwanda Journalists Association (ARJ) on 1st July 2025 for management of shared services at Hallmark Centre building.  

The amendment of the contract  necessitates an 'increase of 1,853,493Frw for cleaning service at the Headquarters of RDRC. The request would raise the contract amount to 3,253,494Frw (2,400.000Frw for cleaning service at the Headquarters of RDRC and 853,494Frw for cleaning services of centers), reflecting an additional increase of 1,853,493Frw representing an increment of +132%.

As per the provision of article article of 89 of Ministerial Order, no: 001/23/10/TC of 10/10/2023 establishing regulations governing public procurement and the RPPA recommendation dated on 8/10/2025 as per the letter Ref:010/2025/2026-0176/RPPA, this amendment is approved by the inter-institutional panel as per the meeting minutes of 24th December 2025. The amendment is effective from 24, December 2025

Reference is also made to the request letter from ESCOGEM Ltd dated on 12/12/2025 addressed to DVC-AF/ RP but received by RP on 24 December 2025 request the extension of 3 months, and this letter also was addressed to Kamali Jean Paul as contract manager by DVC-AF on 30/12/2025 to asses & provide feedback.

Reference is also further made to the recommendation letter from contractor manager dated 06/01/2026 recommending the extension of the contract of three months from 14/01/2026 to 14/04/2026. Based on Article 10 of Public Procurement Law No. 031/2022 of 21/11/2022 which states “the Public Tender Committee and its responsibilities on point 6 regarding providing recommendations on any change to be carried out on the procurement contract”.

It is from the above references that the RP Public Tender Committee would like to recommend the extension of contract No: 00-000006/W/NCB/2024/2025/RP Re-advertised tender for construction of Rehabilitation works for basketball and volleyball Playgrounds at RP Kigali College_Rutongo Campus.
Therefore, based on the above references, RP Public Tender Committee (PTC) recommends extension period of three months, effective from 14/01/2026 to 14/04/2026.

description:
This amendment is made in order to implement the assigned responsibilities as per the Memorandum of Understanding signed between Rwanda Demobilization and reintegration Commission, Rwanda Space Agency (RSA) and Rwanda Journalists Association (ARJ) on 1st July 2025 for management of shared services at Hallmark Centre building.  

The amendment of the contract  necessitates an 'increase of 1,853,493Frw for cleaning service at the Headquarters of RDRC. The request would raise the contract amount to 3,253,494Frw (2,400.000Frw for cleaning service at the Headquarters of RDRC and 853,494Frw for cleaning services of centers), reflecting an additional increase of 1,853,493Frw representing an increment of +132%.

As per the provision of article article of 89 of Ministerial Order, no: 001/23/10/TC of 10/10/2023 establishing regulations governing public procurement and the RPPA recommendation dated on 8/10/2025 as per the letter Ref:010/2025/2026-0176/RPPA, this amendment is approved by the inter-institutional panel as per the meeting minutes of 24th December 2025. The amendment is effective from 24, December 2025

description:
Amendment No. 1 – VAT Compliance Update

This amendment pertains to Law No. 009/2025 (effective May 27, 2025), which revises Law No. 049/2023 on Value Added Tax (VAT). The updated legislation amends Article One by removing the VAT exemptions previously granted under items (q) and (r) of Article 8.

As RISA (the central purchasing body for ICT equipment/services) had entered into supplier contracts under the former VAT-exempt framework, this amendment introduces an 18% VAT on all ICT equipment and services to align with the new legal requirements. All other terms and conditions of the original contract remain unchanged.

description:
CONTRACT AMENDMENT NO. 2

This contract amendment is entered into by and between the Institute of Legal Practice and Development (ILPD) represented by Mr. SHIRIMPUMU N. Erick, the Vice Rector of Administration and Finance, Po Box 49, Nyanza, Rwanda, herein called “the client’;

 and

RUPA BUSINESS Company Ltd, a Company incorporated in Rwanda, represented by RUKUNDO Pascal, the Managing Director hereby called the “Service Provider”.
	
Reference is made to the framework contract No. 000011/NC/NCB/2023/2024/ILPD, entitled Provision of Cleaning and Gardening Services, signed by and between ILPD and RUPA BUSINESS Company Ltd on 12/12/2023 and contract amendment of 11/12/2024.

Considering the letter from Service Provider dated 01/12/2024, requesting the administration to extend the above-mentioned contract as the amended contract will be expired on 12/12/2025.

Pursuant to article 56 of law No. 031/2022 of 21/11/2023 law governing public procurement in Rwanda which states that: “The framework agreement is concluded for a period of one (1) year that can be renewed twice (2)”.

Considering the recommendation of ILPD Public Tender Committee, in its meeting of 10/12/2025, to extend the contract for Provision of Cleaning and Gardening services for a period of one (1) year.

Now    therefore, the parties hereby agree as follows:

Article one: The aim of the contract amendment  
This contract amendment intends to extend the amended contract of 11/12/2024 for provision of cleaning and gardening services. 
Article Two: Extension of contract period
The framework contract of 12/12/2023 and its amendment of 11/12/2024 for the provision of cleaning and gardening services is hereby extended for a period of one (1) year with effect from 12/12/2025 up to 12/12/2026.


Article Three: Repealing inconsistent provision 
Apart from Art.1.3 of GCC of the framework contract of 12/12/2023 for the provision of cleaning and gardening services and its amendment No 1, which is hereby replaced, other provisions remain unchanged.
Article Three: Contractual document
	The contract amendment No 2 of 12/12/2025;
	Negotiation Minute of 08/12/2025
	The contract amendment No 1 of 11/12/2024;
	Initial contract of the 12/12/2023.
In case of any inconsistency between articles of this contract amendment and the framework contract of 12/12/2023, the provisions of the contract amendment shall prevail. 
Article Five: Coming into force 
This contract amendment shall come into effect starting from 12th December 2025.

Done at Nyanza on 12/12/2025

description:
Extension and amendment of contract related to the Upgrading teaching & learning at Rwanda Polytechnic on integrated package (facilities & ICT-enabled pedagogy).  

Reference is made to contract No 000003/G/ICB/2020/2021/RP related to the “Upgrading teaching & learning at Rwanda Polytechnic on integrated package (facilities & ICT-enabled pedagogy)”, initially signed on 24/11/2023 between Rwanda Polytechnic (RP) and Devotra B.V which ended on 30/09/2025 as amended. 

Reference is also made to the letter dated 15/09/2025 from Devotra B.V requesting a contract extension of four (4) months to complete the contract obligations and amendment of contract value. 

Further reference is made to the contract manager’s report (Mr. Anastase NDUWAYEZU) recommending for four (4) months contract extension and amendment, dated, 16/09/2025 after analyzing the supplier’s request.

In accordance with with Article 10 of Law N° 031/2022 of 21st November 2022, which governs public procurement and outlines the responsibilities of the public tender committee, and Article 123 of Ministerial Order n° 001/23/10/ TC of 10/10/2023 establishing regulations governing public procurement explaining the process for contract amendment.

It is from the above references, the Public Tender Committee (PTC) would like to recommend that, the contract with Devotra B.V for the “Upgrading Teaching & Learning at Rwanda Polytechnic on Integrated Package (Facilities & ICT-enabled Pedagogy)” should be increased in cost of civil works and extended for a period of four (4) months from 30/09/2025 to 31/01/2026.

The contract is amended as follows:

1.	Initial value for civil works: EUR 476,898.19 (exclusive of withholding tax) and EUR 561,056.69 (inclusive of withholding tax). The amended value for civil works: EUR 532,333.15 (exclusive of withholding tax) and EUR 626,274.29 (inclusive of withholding tax).
2.	Initial total contract value: EUR 4,053,125.92 (exclusive of withholding tax) and EUR 4,768,383.44 (inclusive of withholding tax). The amended total contract value: EUR 4,108,560.88 (exclusive of withholding tax) and EUR 4,833,601.04 (inclusive of withholding tax).


NB: All other provisions of the initial contract as amended to date, are not changed.

4th no cost Extension

Public Tender Committee (PTC) resolved as follows:
The contract with Devotra B.V. for the project “Upgrading Teaching and Learning at Rwanda Polytechnic through an Integrated Package (Facilities and ICT-Enabled Pedagogy)” 

shall be extended for a period of four (4) months, comprising:
•	Two (2) months to complete all Phase I activities, from 31 January 2026 to 31 March 2026; and
•	Two (2) months dedicated to the review of Phase II contract activities/scop, from 31 March 2026 to 31 May 2026.
Note:
Phase I activities must be completed no later than 31 March 2026. Failure to complete Phase I activities within this timeframe shall result in the application of the relevant legal provisions governing delays in the delivery of contract deliverables, including delay penalties.
All other terms and conditions of the contract shall remain unchanged and shall continue to be binding upon both parties.

Amendment No. 3– VAT Compliance Update

As RISA (the central purchasing body for ICT equipment/services) had entered into supplier contracts under the former VAT-exempt framework, this amendment introduces an 18% VAT on all ICT equipment and services to align with the new legal requirements. All other terms and conditions of the original contract remain unchanged.

description:
CONTRACT AMENDMENT NO. 2

This contract amendment is entered into by and between the Institute of Legal Practice and Development (ILPD) represented by Mr. SHIRIMPUMU N. Erick, the Vice Rector of Administration and Finance, Po Box 49, Nyanza, Rwanda, herein called “the client’;

 and

RUPA BUSINESS Company Ltd, a Company incorporated in Rwanda, represented by RUKUNDO Pascal, the Managing Director hereby called the “Service Provider”.
	
Reference is made to the framework contract No. 000011/NC/NCB/2023/2024/ILPD, entitled Provision of Cleaning and Gardening Services, signed by and between ILPD and RUPA BUSINESS Company Ltd on 12/12/2023 and contract amendment of 11/12/2024.

Considering the letter from Service Provider dated 01/12/2024, requesting the administration to extend the above-mentioned contract as the amended contract will be expired on 12/12/2025.

Pursuant to article 56 of law No. 031/2022 of 21/11/2023 law governing public procurement in Rwanda which states that: “The framework agreement is concluded for a period of one (1) year that can be renewed twice (2)”.

Considering the recommendation of ILPD Public Tender Committee, in its meeting of 10/12/2025, to extend the contract for Provision of Cleaning and Gardening services for a period of one (1) year.

Now    therefore, the parties hereby agree as follows:

Article one: The aim of the contract amendment  
This contract amendment intends to extend the amended contract of 11/12/2024 for provision of cleaning and gardening services. 
Article Two: Extension of contract period
The framework contract of 12/12/2023 and its amendment of 11/12/2024 for the provision of cleaning and gardening services is hereby extended for a period of one (1) year with effect from 12/12/2025 up to 12/12/2026.


Article Three: Repealing inconsistent provision 
Apart from Art.1.3 of GCC of the framework contract of 12/12/2023 for the provision of cleaning and gardening services and its amendment No 1, which is hereby replaced, other provisions remain unchanged.
Article Three: Contractual document
	The contract amendment No 2 of 12/12/2025;
	Negotiation Minute of 08/12/2025
	The contract amendment No 1 of 11/12/2024;
	Initial contract of the 12/12/2023.
In case of any inconsistency between articles of this contract amendment and the framework contract of 12/12/2023, the provisions of the contract amendment shall prevail. 
Article Five: Coming into force 
This contract amendment shall come into effect starting from 12th December 2025.

Done at Nyanza on 12/12/2025

Amendment No. 1 – VAT Compliance Update

This amendment pertains to Law No. 009/2025 (effective May 27, 2025), which revises Law No. 049/2023 on Value Added Tax (VAT). The updated legislation amends Article One by removing the VAT exemptions previously granted under items (q) and (r) of Article 8.

As RISA (the central purchasing body for ICT equipment/services) had entered into supplier contracts under the former VAT-exempt framework, this amendment introduces an 18% VAT on all ICT equipment and services to align with the new legal requirements. All other terms and conditions of the original contract remain unchanged.

CONTRACT AMENDMENT NO. 1

This contract amendment is entered into by and between the Institute of Legal Practice and Development (ILPD) represented by Mr. SHIRIMPUMU N. Erick, the Vice Rector of Administration and Finance, Po Box 49, Nyanza, Rwanda, herein called “the client’;

 and

UNICA Ltd, a Company incorporated in Rwanda, represented by INGABIRE Mugiraneza Deborah, the Managing Director hereby called the “Supplier”.
	
Reference is made to the framework contract No. 00-000011/G/NCB/2024/2025/ILPD/1, entitled Supply of Beverages for ILPD, signed by and between ILPD and UNICA Ltd on 06/02/2025.

Considering the letter from Supplier dated 12/01/2026, requesting the administration to extend the above-mentioned contract as the amended contract will be expired on 06/02/2026.

Pursuant to article 56 of law No. 031/2022 of 21/11/2023 law governing public procurement in Rwanda which states that: “The framework agreement is concluded for a period of one (1) year that can be renewed twice (2)”.

Considering the recommendation of ILPD Public Tender Committee, in its meeting of 15/01/2026, to extend the contract for Supply of Beverages for ILPD for a period of one (1) year.

Now    therefore, the parties hereby agree as follows:

Article one: The aim of the contract amendment  
This contract amendment intends to extend the framework contract of 06/02/2025 for Supply of Beverages for ILPD. 
Article Two: Extension of contract period
The framework contract of 06/02/2025 for the Supply of Beverages for ILPD is hereby extended for a period of one (1) year with effect from 06/02/2026 up to 06/02/2027.




Article Three: Repealing inconsistent provision 
Apart from Art.1.3 of GCC of the framework contract of 06/02/2025 for the Supply of Beverages for ILPD, which is hereby replaced, other provisions remain unchanged.
Article Three: Contractual document
	The contract amendment No 1 of 16/01/2026;
	Initial contract of the 06/02/2025.
In case of any inconsistency between articles of this contract amendment and the framework contract of 06/02/2025, the provisions of the contract amendment shall prevail. 
Article Five: Coming into force 
This contract amendment shall come into effect starting from 06th February 2026.

Done at Nyanza on 16/01/2026

description:
CONTRACT AMENDMENT NO. 1

This contract amendment is entered into by and between the Institute of Legal Practice and Development (ILPD) represented by Mr. SHIRIMPUMU N. Erick, the Vice Rector of Administration and Finance, Po Box 49, Nyanza, Rwanda, herein called “the client’;

 and

BROCOLI COMPANY Ltd, a Company incorporated in Rwanda, represented by MUKANSANGA Marie Rose, the Managing Director hereby called the “Supplier”.
	
Reference is made to the framework contract No. 01-000008/G/NCB/2024/2025/ILPD, entitled Supply of Electrical Equipment, signed by and between ILPD and BROCOLI COMPANY Ltd on 21/01/2025.

Considering the letter from Supplier dated 05/01/2026, requesting the administration to extend the above-mentioned contract as the contract will be expired on 21/01/2026.

Pursuant to article 56 of law No. 031/2022 of 21/11/2023 law governing public procurement in Rwanda which states that: “The framework agreement is concluded for a period of one (1) year that can be renewed twice (2)”.

Considering the recommendation of ILPD Public Tender Committee, in its meeting of 20/01/2026, to extend the contract for Supply of Electrical Equipment for a period of three (3) months.

Now    therefore, the parties hereby agree as follows:

Article one: The aim of the contract amendment  
This contract amendment intends to extend the framework contract of 21/01/2025 for Supply of Electrical Equipment. 
Article Two: Extension of contract period
The framework contract of 21/01/2025 for the Supply of Electrical Equipment is hereby extended for a period of Three (3) Months with effect from 21/01/2026 up to 21/04/2026 but this contract amendment shall automatically be terminated once new tendering process is done.


Article Three: Repealing inconsistent provision 
Apart from Art.1.3 of GCC of the framework contract of 21/01/2025 for the Supply of Electrical Equipment, which is hereby replaced, other provisions remain unchanged.
Article Three: Contractual document
	The contract amendment No 1 of 20/01/2026;
	Initial contract of the 21/01/2025.
In case of any inconsistency between articles of this contract amendment and the framework contract of 21/01/2025, the provisions of the contract amendment shall prevail. 
Article Five: Coming into force 
This contract amendment shall come into effect starting from 21st January 2026.

Done at Nyanza on 20/01/2026

CONTRACT AMENDMENT NO. 1

This contract amendment is entered into by and between the Institute of Legal Practice and Development (ILPD) represented by Mr. SHIRIMPUMU N. Erick, the Vice Rector of Administration and Finance, Po Box 49, Nyanza, Rwanda, herein called “the client’;

 and

BROCOLI COMPANY Ltd, a Company incorporated in Rwanda, represented by MUKANSANGA Marie Rose, the Managing Director hereby called the “Supplier”.
	
Reference is made to the framework contract No. 01-000008/G/NCB/2024/2025/ILPD, entitled Supply of Electrical Equipment, signed by and between ILPD and BROCOLI COMPANY Ltd on 21/01/2025.

Considering the letter from Supplier dated 05/01/2026, requesting the administration to extend the above-mentioned contract as the contract will be expired on 21/01/2026.

Pursuant to article 56 of law No. 031/2022 of 21/11/2023 law governing public procurement in Rwanda which states that: “The framework agreement is concluded for a period of one (1) year that can be renewed twice (2)”.

Considering the recommendation of ILPD Public Tender Committee, in its meeting of 20/01/2026, to extend the contract for Supply of Electrical Equipment for a period of three (3) months.

Now    therefore, the parties hereby agree as follows:

Article one: The aim of the contract amendment  
This contract amendment intends to extend the framework contract of 21/01/2025 for Supply of Electrical Equipment. 
Article Two: Extension of contract period
The framework contract of 21/01/2025 for the Supply of Electrical Equipment is hereby extended for a period of Three (3) Months with effect from 21/01/2026 up to 21/04/2026 but this contract amendment shall automatically be terminated once new tendering process is done.


Article Three: Repealing inconsistent provision 
Apart from Art.1.3 of GCC of the framework contract of 21/01/2025 for the Supply of Electrical Equipment, which is hereby replaced, other provisions remain unchanged.
Article Three: Contractual document
	The contract amendment No 1 of 20/01/2026;
	Initial contract of the 21/01/2025.
In case of any inconsistency between articles of this contract amendment and the framework contract of 21/01/2025, the provisions of the contract amendment shall prevail. 
Article Five: Coming into force 
This contract amendment shall come into effect starting from 21st January 2026.

Done at Nyanza on 20/01/2026

description:
Extension and amendment of contract related to the Upgrading teaching & learning at Rwanda Polytechnic on integrated package (facilities & ICT-enabled pedagogy).  

Reference is made to contract No 000003/G/ICB/2020/2021/RP related to the “Upgrading teaching & learning at Rwanda Polytechnic on integrated package (facilities & ICT-enabled pedagogy)”, initially signed on 24/11/2023 between Rwanda Polytechnic (RP) and Devotra B.V which ended on 30/09/2025 as amended. 

Reference is also made to the letter dated 15/09/2025 from Devotra B.V requesting a contract extension of four (4) months to complete the contract obligations and amendment of contract value. 

Further reference is made to the contract manager’s report (Mr. Anastase NDUWAYEZU) recommending for four (4) months contract extension and amendment, dated, 16/09/2025 after analyzing the supplier’s request.

In accordance with with Article 10 of Law N° 031/2022 of 21st November 2022, which governs public procurement and outlines the responsibilities of the public tender committee, and Article 123 of Ministerial Order n° 001/23/10/ TC of 10/10/2023 establishing regulations governing public procurement explaining the process for contract amendment.

It is from the above references, the Public Tender Committee (PTC) would like to recommend that, the contract with Devotra B.V for the “Upgrading Teaching & Learning at Rwanda Polytechnic on Integrated Package (Facilities & ICT-enabled Pedagogy)” should be increased in cost of civil works and extended for a period of four (4) months from 30/09/2025 to 31/01/2026.

The contract is amended as follows:

1.	Initial value for civil works: EUR 476,898.19 (exclusive of withholding tax) and EUR 561,056.69 (inclusive of withholding tax). The amended value for civil works: EUR 532,333.15 (exclusive of withholding tax) and EUR 626,274.29 (inclusive of withholding tax).
2.	Initial total contract value: EUR 4,053,125.92 (exclusive of withholding tax) and EUR 4,768,383.44 (inclusive of withholding tax). The amended total contract value: EUR 4,108,560.88 (exclusive of withholding tax) and EUR 4,833,601.04 (inclusive of withholding tax).


NB: All other provisions of the initial contract as amended to date, are not changed.

4th no cost Extension

Public Tender Committee (PTC) resolved as follows:
The contract with Devotra B.V. for the project “Upgrading Teaching and Learning at Rwanda Polytechnic through an Integrated Package (Facilities and ICT-Enabled Pedagogy)” 

shall be extended for a period of four (4) months, comprising:
•	Two (2) months to complete all Phase I activities, from 31 January 2026 to 31 March 2026; and
•	Two (2) months dedicated to the review of Phase II contract activities/scop, from 31 March 2026 to 31 May 2026.
Note:
Phase I activities must be completed no later than 31 March 2026. Failure to complete Phase I activities within this timeframe shall result in the application of the relevant legal provisions governing delays in the delivery of contract deliverables, including delay penalties.
All other terms and conditions of the contract shall remain unchanged and shall continue to be binding upon both parties.

Amendment No. 1 – VAT Compliance Update

This amendment pertains to Law No. 009/2025 (effective May 27, 2025), which revises Law No. 049/2023 on Value Added Tax (VAT). The updated legislation amends Article One by removing the VAT exemptions previously granted under items (q) and (r) of Article 8.

As RISA (the central purchasing body for ICT equipment/services) had entered into supplier contracts under the former VAT-exempt framework, this amendment introduces an 18% VAT on all ICT equipment and services to align with the new legal requirements. All other terms and conditions of the original contract remain unchanged.
